A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Latent Drifting work, with reliably matchable text, equations, tables, and figures. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix, although both reference separate supplementary material that cannot be assessed here.

before.justification: V1 reports original medical-image generation, counterfactual editing, and classification experiments, including quantitative results in Tables 1–4.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and their quantitative and qualitative outcomes in Tables 1–4 and the experimental figures.

M1.justification: Sections 3.3–3.4 retain the same additive latent drift, its application during fine-tuning and inference, and L1-based grid search for the drift parameter. No algorithmic component or objective changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use ADNI-1, OASIS-3, and CheXpert for the same generation, counterfactual manipulation, and classification evaluations. The natural-image inference examples in Figure 2 also remain unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Custom Diffusion, DreamBooth, Textual Inversion, and Stable Diffusion with the same fine-tuning comparisons. Table 2 retains the same three backbones for every aging prompt style; citation renumbering does not change comparator membership.

E3.justification: The SD-v1.4 backbone, dataset counts, 200-image brain MRI and 400-image chest X-ray test sets, classification procedures, prompt variants, and metrics remain unchanged. Table 1 also retains the same 50% real/synthetic mixture.

E4.justification: The LD comparisons, latent-distribution visualizations, prompt-style ablations in Tables 3–4, and counterfactual case studies are retained. References to supplementary parameter ablations and a user study are unchanged, without those materials appearing in either PDF.

E5.justification: The tables retain point estimates without added repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The distribution visualizations and statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–4 match, as do the qualitative examples. For example, Basic FT plus LD retains FID values of 49.68 for brain MRI and 84 for CheXpert. Relocated figures do not introduce new results.

T1.justification: Equations 1–5, the counterfactual formulation, and the latent-space adaptation argument are unchanged. Equation 5 moves between pages without mathematical revision; no proof or formal result is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about fine-tuning-agnostic latent drifting, distribution adaptation, counterfactual medical-image synthesis, and improved generation and downstream classification.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same explanations concerning latent-distribution stability, brain-image realism, prompt conditioning, and ventricular and atrophy changes. No substantive interpretation, applicability boundary, or limitation is added.

D1.justification: V1 promises source-code release upon acceptance; v2 removes that statement and adds a project-page link on the first page. Implementation disclosures otherwise remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether code is available.

R1.justification: V2 adds references to Autopaint, physics-informed latent diffusion for multimodal brain MRI synthesis, and anatomy-aware masking, while removing several earlier references, including MIGS and cascaded refinement networks. The overall related-work framework and novelty positioning remain stable.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized wording edits, revises author ordering, affiliations and contribution notes, adds contact information, and introduces acknowledgments. The main section organization and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: V2 replaces pervasive italic body and bibliography text with upright type and adjusts the author block and float placement. The aging example moves from Figure 8 to Figure 6, subsequent figures are renumbered, and Tables 3–4 move columns. The visual content and two-column design remain.

improvement.justification: V2 improves readability through upright body and bibliography typography, light copyediting, and clearer resource signposting through the project-page link. These are modest presentation and access-information gains; the method, empirical evidence, mathematical support, and implementation detail remain unchanged.
